# Handoff Acknowledged

## Status Summary

| Metric | Champion (v5) | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|--------------|---------------------|
| Tuning Mean | **3.53** | 1.76 |
| Tuning Min | **1.58** | 0.05 |
| Lockbox Mean | **4.06** | 1.79 |
| Lockbox Min | **3.32** | 1.35 |
| Worst MDD | — | -11.2% |

**Assessment**: Champion remains dominant. Last passing candidate (`exp_macro_alpha_shadow`) underperforms by ~50% on both tuning and lockbox metrics. The very low tuning min (0.05) suggests instability on at least one fold.

## Runloop Health
- ✅ 17 loops completed in ~1h44m (~6 min/loop average)
- ✅ ~46 hours remaining — sufficient runway
- ✅ No stuck INCONCLUSIVE candidates

## Recommended Action

Proceed with suggested commands:

```bash
# 1. Explore module-level improvements
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

# 2. Test system-level configurations  
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run

# 3. Generate diagnostic report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

The gap between champion and candidate suggests focusing on:
- Fold stability (address the 0.05 tuning min outlier)
- MDD management (current worst -11.2% may be acceptable depending on constraints)

Standing by for next handoff or escalation. 🔄
